RoadNav v0.7.0

RoadNav implementation and original chevron geometry: CryKitty's RoadNav project.
No additional reuse license for the original RoadNav code is granted by this
notice. Third-party terms remain applicable.

Native GTA IV ScriptHook / ScriptHook SDK: Aru, Copyright (C) 2009, Aru.
The included SCRIPT-HOOK-LICENSE.txt is the SDK license used by this project.
Its terms include a non-commercial restriction. Preserve these notices and that
license with this release. Dependency DLLs are not included in this package.

The SDK D3D hook service interface was adapted with local pure-interface
declarations to avoid importing interface constructors. Its original copyright
and license notice remain in the repository source header.

GPS route memory layout documentation:
https://github.com/garuspl/gta4-gps-hud
No original C# code, DLLs or artwork from that project are bundled here.

The mod contains no Rockstar game assets and is not affiliated with Rockstar
Games, Take-Two Interactive, Square Enix, or the creators of Sleeping Dogs.
The chevron artwork is original geometric drawing, not extracted artwork.
